packageRules.description: Hold Plate on the 53.3 line: platejs 53.3.18+ and 53.5 pin slate 0.146, which breaks editor slash-menu filtering (udecode/plate#5149). Remove together with the @platejs/core, @platejs/slate and @platejs/utils resolutions in package.json once a fixed release ships.
Stay on Node 24 (the Vercel runtime and .nvmrc). Node major upgrades are a deliberate decision, so Renovate does not propose them; patch and minor updates within 24.x still come through.
